paragraphs: Friend, this passage is HEAVY, so let me say the heart of it plain. God wanted a people who listen to Him. He says what He commanded their fathers was this: "Obey Me, and I will be your God, and you will be My people." (Jeremiah 7:23) Sacrifices were never supposed to stand in for that.

God sent His servants the prophets "again and again," and still they "would not listen to Me or incline their ear." (Jeremiah 7:25-26) They followed their own stubborn hearts, and God says they went "backward and not forward." (Jeremiah 7:24) I think this one hurts most, because He kept calling the whole time, and He even asks, "Is it not themselves they spite, to their own shame?" (Jeremiah 7:19) Turning away from God is never a small thing, and it costs the people who do it.

So here's what I take home, baker. When God speaks, I want to be the one who leans in and listens. I want to hear Him and do what He says, because I love Him, not so I can check a box. Open ears, friend, that's what I'm baking with today.
